# Vendored front-end libraries

Bundled so the platform runs with no internet access — relevant when handling
licensed Fathom data on a closed network.

| File | Library | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `leaflet.js`, `leaflet.css`, `images/` | [Leaflet](https://leafletjs.com) | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause |
| `chart.umd.js` | [Chart.js](https://www.chartjs.org) | 4.4.4 | MIT |

Both are unmodified official distribution builds from their npm packages.
